receipt-settings.027:
🖨️ Thermal printer se receipt print karna

1️⃣ Printer ke roll ke mutabiq size set karein:
• 80mm roll (aam, 3 inch): receipt size 80mm
• 58mm roll (chota, 2 inch): receipt size 58mm
• Sada A4/A5 printer: receipt size A4 ya A5

2️⃣ "receipt 12" likhein — PDF aayegi.

3️⃣ PDF khol kar Share / Print karein:
• Bluetooth thermal printer: Android par RawBT ya "Bluetooth Print" app mein share karein, printer pair karein, Print dabayein.
• WiFi/USB printer: phone ki Print service (Settings → Printing) ya printer ki apni app.
• Computer par: email ali@shop.com set karein, phir "email receipt 12" — email kholkar print karein.

4️⃣ Pehle ek test receipt chhapein. Kat jaye ya chhoti aaye to 80mm/58mm dobara check karein, aur print app mein "Actual size" chunein ("Fit to page" nahi).

Apni line: receipt footer ... · Order ka note: note 12 ... · Sab settings: receipt settings

ℹ️ Bot printer se seedha nahi jud sakta — print aapke phone/computer ki app se hota hai.
